prompt: We just created tasks/prd.json for the billing export feature in this session. Run it with ralph.

assertions.text: Uses the JSON task file as the source (json tracker) and does not require or point to beads
Lists the 12 stories in dependency order (a linear chain US-001 to US-012)
Flags that the quality gates cannot run in this checkout (toolchain not installed)
Flags that there is no git remote and what that blocks
Flags that the stories' acceptance criteria ("<title> works") cannot be checked
States that ralph-tui rewrites tasks/prd.json during the run and what that means for commits or the working tree
Does not treat branchName as a branch ralph-tui will create; proposes the branch itself following the project's convention (feat/<topic>) or says why not
Plans to start ralph-tui headless with --prd pointing at the task file (not --epic and not the interactive picker)
Presents delivery options without picking, recommending or defaulting to one, and asks the user to choose
Proposes an iteration budget above 12 and states the headroom
Sends one plan for confirmation and does not start ralph-tui
Leaves the project unchanged (no files edited, tasks/prd.json untouched)
